headings.text: ​"Voice of MGM" - Our School Radio Club

voice-of-mgm.fullText:
​"Voice of MGM" - Our School Radio Club


The “Voice of MGM” Radio Club provides a unique platform for students to build confidence, develop public speaking skills, and showcase their creativity. Running a radio show fosters teamwork, communication, and commitment.

Our user-friendly systems encourage participation from students of all ages and abilities. Unlike camera or stage performances, speaking into a microphone in a closed room can be less intimidating, allowing students to express themselves freely.

​Inaugurated by Rashmi Roja Thushara Nair IAS, Bureau Director of the Press Information Bureau, our Radio Club empowers students to share their ideas and opinions, giving them a confident voice.

hindustan-scouts-guides.fullText:
Hindustan Scouts & Guides.


​​As part of our mission to foster character development and nurture responsible citizens, MGM Model School, Ayiroor, Varkala has partnered with Hindustan Scouts and Guides Kerala since 2019.

​​Our School proudly hosts:

1 Scout Troop
​1 Guide Company
​1 Rover-Ranger unit

​​Under the guidance of trained instructors – Mr. Pravin S R and Mr. Binukumar C,126 cadets are actively engaged in scouting activities. Notably, 31 cadets have earned the prestigious Rajyapuraskar (Governor’s Award) over the past five years.

swimming-pool.title: Swimming Pool – MGM School
swimming-pool.fullText:
​Introducing Our Swimming Pool Facility!


We’re excited to announce the addition of a state-of-the-art swimming pool to our campus, designed to enhance physical fitness and provide a new dimension to our students’ educational experience.

Our facility features two pools, including one exclusively for children under 8 years old. The pools are designed and constructed with the highest safety standards in mind, and our well-trained and qualified trainers will provide expert guidance.

Our comprehensive swimming program for children will cover the following skills and strokes:

Breathing Techniques
Water Body Balance and Gliding
Kicking and Arm Action
Side Breathing
Full Stroke Freestyle
Backstroke
Breaststroke

ncc.title: NCC – MGM School
ncc.fullText:
NCC (National Cadet Corps) @ MGM

National Cadet Corps (NCC) is the biggest youth organization functioning under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. It inculcates discipline and sense of unity and patriotism in youth and trains in defense preparedness.

MGM Model School has started NCC unit, ‘Kerala Lakshyadeep Group One Kerala Battalion’ on 7th July 2022 with NCC cadets from the junior wing of class VIII. It functions as a self-financing scheme with 2 years of service. After completing 2 years of service in the National Cadet Corps (NCC), cadets are awarded a certificate. This certificate is a recognition of their dedication, hard work, and commitment to the NCC. It can also be beneficial for their future careers, as it demonstrates their leadership skills, discipline, and sense of responsibility.

Students are given training on Fridays from 3 PM to 5:30 PM with basic military parades, small arms training, drills, community service. Cadets also participate in camps and expeditions, developing leadership skills and a sense of patriotism. The Associate NCC Officer of MGM is Mr. Binu Kumar C.

attendance.title: Attendance – MGM School
attendance.fullText:
Attendance
Every student must have compulsory 75% attendance in an academic session. Medical certificate or other necessary documents must be produced to the school authorities for the leave already availed Leave shall be granted only when it is absolutely necessary or on medical grounds. Leave should be marked on the stipulated page in the Diary. Student shall not be allowed to attend the class without leave application on the day he/she presents himself/herself after leave. Students with perfect attendance (100%) will be honoured with certificates on the Convocation day

alumni.title: Alumni – MGM School
alumni.fullText:
Alumni Association of M.G.M. Model School is very active. It holds its annual meeting on December 24th every year in the school auditorium. The chief objective of the association is to keep in touch with our former students and solicit their sincere co-operation and suggestions to pool ideas for the upliftment of the school as a Centre of Excellence. The Alumni Association has a record of the present status and whereabouts of a majority of the students who have already passed out from the school. Once in a while the students of a same batch meet in the school and conduct a get together. Such reunions are helpful to the school as they conduct useful programmes like career guidance, social work, workshops etc.

merit-day.title: Merit Day – MGM School
merit-day.fullText:
Investiture Ceremony
Our school’s Investiture Ceremony is a time-honoured tradition where student leaders are chosen through a selective interview process to take on key roles as Head Boy and Head Girl, Deputy Head Boy / Head Girl. These student leaders play a vital role in maintaining discipline, leading morning assemblies and supporting various school events. By shouldering these responsibilities, they gain invaluable experience and opportunities to develop essential leadership skills. The Investiture Ceremony, held during a special school assembly, marks the formal handing over of responsibilities to these newly elected office bearers, as they embark on their journey to shape the school’s future.
Amma School
Amma School was established with the noble aim of empowering parents with the knowledge and skills to raise confident and resilient children. In today’s fast-paced world, children face numerous challenges that require guidance and support. Through Amma School, we strive to create awareness among parents about the various issues adolescents encounter and provide them with practical strategies to nurture their children into responsible citizens. Our awareness classes are expertly conducted by renowned social workers, psychiatrists, doctors and other specialists. The Amma School program is held every second Saturday and was inaugurated by Sri. Udit Chaithanya, marking the beginning of a journey to foster positive change in our community
Convocation Day

A grand ceremony held annually in the first week of April to mark an important milestone in our students' academic journey.

Fresher’s Day

A vibrant celebration to welcome and integrate new students, making their transition to our school a memorable experience.

Toppers’ Day

A celebration to honor and recognize the academic excellence of students who top the AISSCE, AISSE and other internal and external exams, with certificates presented to the high achievers.

MGM Expo

An annual exhibition that empowers students to unleash their hidden talents and showcase their innovative ideas.

Arts Festival

Our Arts Festival is a vibrant 4-day celebration, typically held in August, where students showcase their artistic talents across various disciplines.

Annual Day

Our Annual Day is a grand celebration of student talent, creativity, and achievement. Held annually, typically in January.

Sports Day
Our Annual Sports Day is a celebration of teamwork, sportsmanship and healthy competition. It’s a platform for our students to showcase their talents, build confidence and develop essential life skills. By participating in various sports and games, our students learn to overcome challenges, work together and strive for excellence.

pta.title: PTA – MGM School
pta.fullText: M G M Model School is a community school. So a strong PTA is an inevitable feature. The school gives due importance to the PTA meetings. The PTA works on three levels – (1) Class room PTA, (2) PTA class representative – Executive meetings and (3) PTA Executive meetings. The PTA Class representative – Executive meeting has been converted into the General body. When the parents of nearly 3000 students participate in the General body meetings, it is natural that all of them cannot voice their opinions or complaints here. Hence it was decided to elect a class representative and an Executive member from each class. These elected members collect the suggestions, opinions and complaints from the other parents of the class they represent and present them at the PTA Executive meetings held on the second Saturday of each month. The class representatives are the chairpersons of the class room PTA meeting held each term. The class representatives and Executive members together elect the PTA President and PTA Vice President. The PTA Secretary, is elected by the teaching staff and PTA members from among the senior teachers.

about-us.title: About Us – MGM School
about-us.fullText:
ABOUT US
A Legacy of Excellence
Since 1983

“Success is not about being the best. It’s about being better than you were yesterday.”

MGM Model School’s 41-year journey began in 1983 with five students, founded by dedicated social workers under Aikya Pradayini Trust’s patronage. The late Padma Shri Prem Nazir laid the foundation stone. The school offers classes from Standard I to XII, along with pre-school, play school, and Kids School programs. The Kids International School, inaugurated by Education Minister Shri Abdu Rabb in 2012, is a notable addition.

From humble beginnings in a small rented building, MGM Model School has grown into a full-fledged institution with cutting-edge facilities, including an Innovation Lab, three digital libraries, an audio recording studio, a giant globe, swimming pools, and a 3D Maths Zone. These resources foster curiosity and interest in learning among our 2,700+ students from pre-primary to senior secondary.

Our institution strives to provide international-standard education, leveraging modern technologies and techniques to promote all-round development, character-building, and 21st-century skills. We also offer opportunities for community service, instilling values in our students.

Notable events include the Silver Jubilee celebrations, inaugurated by Kerala Governor Shri R. L. Bhatia in 2007 and valedicted by former President Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam. His equation for knowledge—creativity + righteousness + courage—has become a guiding principle for our creative and value-based learning approach.

We’re honored that our innovative 20-20 methodology, initiated by Trust Secretary Dr. P. K. Sukumaran, was acknowledged and appreciated by Kerala Governor Shri Arif Mohammed Khan. Our team of qualified and dedicated teachers provide stimulating education, adhering to Mahatma Gandhi’s principles and values.

Our motto is the nation’s reconstruction and integration, and we spare no effort in upholding these ideals.

Enquire Now
